div.div: Dashed arrows into and out of the Outbox bar are domain events (PRD section 11 'Emits / consumes'). Arrows from a module go down into the bar (emit); arrows from the bar go to subscribers. Module names follow the PRD module table; milestones follow ROADMAP. The Verification → Identity arrow is a service.py call.
